test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electronic Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following calipers are used for marking lines, parallel to inside and outside edges and for locating the centre of round bars?
solution:
The calipers used for **marking lines parallel to inside and outside edges** and for **locating the centre of round bars** are **leg and point calipers**.

 
• 
 
One leg has a **pointed tip** for scribing lines.

 
 
• 
 
The other leg is shaped to **run along the edge or surface** as a guide.

 
 
• 
 
This makes them suitable for layout and marking work.
